import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p=params
    st=np.sqrt(t); s1=np.sqrt(1+t); sP=np.sqrt(P); lP=np.log(P)
    return (p[0]+p[1]*s1+P*(p[2]+p[3]*t)+p[4]*P**2+p[5]*P**3
            + st*(p[6]*P+p[7]*sP)+p[8]*P*lP+p[9]*t*P*lP)
